items.title: France riots: AI photos falsely depict elderly couple ‘stripped and robbed’
items.summary: AI-generated photos falsely claiming to show an elderly couple being “stripped and robbed” during unrest in France have racked up millions of views. Amplified by far-right accounts, the images fuelled inflammatory claims about Muslims, Jews and the riots. The FRANCE 24 Observers traced one image to an AI photo montage published by a pro-Israel account. The images were created using OpenAI tools, and the alleged assault remains unverified, with no official reports confirming the attack.

items.title: France faces reckoning with public order policing after violent protest weekend

In the violent clashes that erupted, law enforcement officers and protesters were wounded, public buildings were set ablaze and businesses were looted, raising significant questions about the French police's approach to public order.

items.title: French far right seeks to capitalise on protests with calls for law and order

FRANCE 24's Selina Sykes reports.
